title: Set up a local model without false locality
steps: Inspect the daemon host and the meaning of loopback (local to the daemon, not necessarily the laptop).
Choose the configured local adapter (for example Ollama-compatible) and test the exact endpoint from the daemon host.
Compare declared and observed context allocation; show the runtime observation source, never infer from the model name.
Review the data boundary before configuring an embedder. An absent embedder keeps lexical/symbol retrieval.
Choose the retrieval fallback and capture a context preview in S08.
Offer allocation/keep-alive/unload controls only where the adapter owns and can acknowledge them.
forbidden_fake_states: "Local" inferred from a URL on the laptop
observed allocation fabricated from the model name
a private-LAN route shown as enabled
semantic index claimed without an embedder
complete_when: a ready local route is explicit and observed usage remains unavailable until a durable read exists (p.183).
